{"id":2048549426,"question_id":4348,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks, 4 days","timestamp":1782622485,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"184 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2048549426/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Total Sum of K Selected Elements","memory":"187.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long maxSum(vector<int>& nums, int k, int mul) {\n        sort(rbegin(nums) , rend(nums));\n\n        long long ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(k == 0) break;\n            if(mul > 0) ans += ((ll)mul * (ll)nums[i]);\n            else ans += nums[i];\n            mul--;\n            k--;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-total-sum-of-k-selected-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2252}
